# DKR-034: Docker Engine is supported upstream

- **Group:** Docker
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

A Docker Engine release line past its end of support gets no security fixes, including fixes for container escapes. stackward ships a table of end of support dates (from endoflife.date, docker-engine) and compares it with the audit date; a line newer than the table counts as supported.

## Verify by hand

```sh
docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}'
```

## How to fix it

Upgrade Docker Engine from Docker's apt repository (docker-ce) to a supported release line.

## What a fix can break

An engine upgrade restarts the daemon and, without live-restore, every container.
